body:
> Side question: is `setQueryParameter` kept in helper ?

@tkrugg Yes `setQueryParameter` is kept inside both Helper & `SearchParameters`. The reason is that it does some additional checks (like [shallow equality](https://github.com/algolia/algoliasearch-helper-js/blob/ffa13f45dd4a71d0a148ecd72fa1da6fb8da4c4f/src/SearchParameters/index.js#L1323-L1331)) to avoid creating a new instance for no reason. Its usage is not equivalent to: `helper.state.value = 'myValue';`. On the other hand, the usage of the getter is equivalent.

> I assume that's expected until the whole stack is merged?

Yes: https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/pull/3804.
